topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Well, now! I heard tell that the finest lines and colors a man's seen this side of the mountain was found etched right onto the skin of a wandering minstrel. How’s that for a turn in the tale? The artist, who's usually as quiet as a field mouse, now paces like a wolf around the village square, asking questions, looking for answers. They say the work is near flawless, each stroke as if it danced upon the skin. I reckon the artist'll have his hands full sorting the who and why of it all. Can't say as I've ever seen the like. What next, I wonder? The mysteries of this world never cease to show their hand in the most unexpected ways.
